laws.rule: Visitors to Boracay (Malay, Aklan) register and pay through the Boracay iPass system run for the Aklan provincial government, and enter with the QR code it issues. The rate guide lists a one-way port terminal fee of PHP 150 (about A$3.35, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) and an environmental fee of PHP 300 (about A$6.69) for foreign guests; children pay neither.
laws.heading: Provincial Government of Aklan

local-law.note: Boracay is in Aklan province; the place tree holds Western Visayas region.

layers.authority: Provincial Government of Aklan (Boracay iPass portal), with the Municipality of Malay
layers.process: To enter Boracay Island, visitors register online on the Boracay iPass portal and get a personal QR code, which is scanned at entry and exit. The registration asks for arrival and departure dates, hotel accommodation, purpose of travel and travel details. The portal lists a Port Terminal Fee (paid to the Provincial Government of Aklan) and an Environmental Fee (paid to the Municipal Government of Malay), plus the boat fare. Children aged 5 and under are exempt from the terminal pass with proof uploaded. Bookings are not refundable but can be transferred until the QR is scanned. The amounts are not printed on the page read; the portal shows them during booking.
